claims.statement: For independent cap-one real X,Y,Z and arbitrary affine terms, an arrow quadratic matrix [[a,b,c],[b,lambda,0],[c,0,d]] whose eigenvalues all have modulus at least s>0 has density L-infinity at most 8/s.

For independent cap-one X,Y,Z_k, normalized u and L=u dot Z, the form aX^2+2bXY+lambda Y^2+2BXL+theta L^2 has density L-infinity at most 16 whenever its effective 3x3 matrix [[a,b,B],[b,lambda,0],[B,0,theta]] has all eigenvalues of modulus at least one.

The target spectral hypothesis does not force a universal positive angle between a rank-one bank-curvature direction and its center-coupling direction; an explicit target-valid family has angle tending to zero.

partner_applied.application: Exact-rank cross banks of rank at least three are paid; O0 exact rank three is closed, and heavy-core sizes three/four reduce to a projected-residual determinant/scale branch. The retained r15 low-offdiagonal theorem leaves only s2(A-diag A)>499/1000.

other_sources_applied.application: Pays the indefinite binary Schur residual after selecting a quantitatively large physical leaf pivot in the arrow theorem.
Baseline pure star-bank endpoint; the new theorem extends it to aligned rank-one internal bank curvature.
